# Задача: журнал состояния блокировки iOS

`lockstate.txt` — выдержка из системных логов и данных Secure Enclave.
Определи состояния BFU/AFU, задержки попыток и USB Restricted Mode, найди метку.

1. `cat lockstate.txt`.
2. `grep -iE 'bfu|afu|usb' lockstate.txt`.
3. `grep nto lockstate.txt > found.txt`.

2026-03-11T07:00:00Z boot: state=BFU (before first unlock)
2026-03-11T07:02:11Z passcode ok: state=AFU (after first unlock)
2026-03-11T07:02:12Z class keys loaded: WhenUnlocked, AfterFirstUnlock
2026-03-11T07:40:00Z failed passcode attempt #3: delay 60s
2026-03-11T07:41:30Z USB connected: USB Restricted Mode armed (1h)
2026-03-11T08:41:00Z device locked 1h: state=AFU keybag still in memory
